items.title: Running Codex safely at OpenAI
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Codex is deployed internally with sandboxing, approvals, network controls, and audit logs.
items.content: OpenAI describes internal safety controls for Codex in engineering workflows, including permission boundaries, network policy, human approval, and detailed agent logs.

items.title: Vasicek Model Implementation in Python
items.summary: A tutorial explaining how to simulate interest-rate paths with the Vasicek model.
items.content: The article walks through a Python implementation of the Vasicek interest-rate model and explains how mean reversion can be used in rate simulation, risk management, and derivatives pricing examples.
